name: ITS Printing Services at Leavey
blurb: Poster and large-format printing on plotters, and 3D printing by request, run by ITS. Ordinary page printing is also at King Hall and Waite Phillips Hall; large-format printing is at Leavey only.
hours_note: Hours are not listed on the printing page. Check the ITS computing centers page.
access_steps: Load discretionary funds on your USC Card: printing is paid for with the card before the job prints.
For a poster, bring your file to the Leavey computing center. ITS staff are on site during opening hours.
For a 3D print, email spaces@usc.edu with your request.

equipment.name: Large-format plotters
equipment.work_area_note: Prints 10 to 48 in wide, up to 100 in long, in color or black and white

materials.name: Poster print on heavyweight coated (matte) paper
materials.price_source: https://itservices.usc.edu/learning-environments-services/usc-computing-center-printing-services/ (read 2026-11-14): $1 per inch of the longest dimension

materials.price_source: https://itservices.usc.edu/learning-environments-services/usc-computing-center-printing-services/ (read 2026-11-14): per inch of the longest dimension

services.name: 3D printing by request
steps: Email spaces@usc.edu with your file and what you need.
ITS staff reply about whether and when they can print it. The page lists no price for 3D printing, so ask.
Collect it when they tell you it is ready.

usage_fee_note: Printing is paid for with a valid USC Card before the job prints. Posters are priced per inch of the longest side.

estimates.cost_note: 3D printing likely costs materials only; the page lists no price. Where no price is listed, cost ranges use typical prices for buying the material yourself.
